title: ChatGPT vs Claude Default Personality: Benchmark Data
description: Compare ChatGPT (GPT-6) and Claude (Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1) personality test scores, MBTI tie rates, DISC floors, and how custom instructions change replies.
h1: ChatGPT vs. Claude personality: what default benchmarks actually show.
dek: Measured across 2,000 independent fresh runs on GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, and Claude Fable 5.1—plus how each responds to tuning.
lede: Most ChatGPT vs. Claude personality comparisons rely on vibes after two prompts. Across September 2026 fresh-session testing (100 independent API calls per model per questionnaire across OEJTS MBTI, OEPS Enneagram, ODAT DISC, IPIP-50 Big Five, and ECR-R Attachment), all four OpenAI and Anthropic models clustered in a remarkably narrow band—until tie-breaking and user instruction overrides exposed real behavioral differences.
answer: Out of the box, GPT-6 models (Astra, Sol) and Claude models (Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1) all test high on Big Five Agreeableness (44.99–47.07/50) and Openness (43.93–46.87/50), and low on DISC Dominance (4.00–5.42/20). The sharpest measured divergence is MBTI repeatability: Claude Fable 5.1 resolved INTJ in 98/100 runs with 1 tie, whereas GPT-6 Astra tied on 29/100 runs (only 19 strict INTJ). Custom instructions shift delivery structure far more than switching model vendors.

sections.h2: One portable rule set that works cleanly in both ChatGPT and Claude.
sections.html:
Instead of writing two conflicting instruction personalities from scratch, use a single concise behavioral block (safe under ChatGPT’s 1,500-char box and effective in Claude’s Profile Preferences):

## Cross-platform working style - Put the direct conclusion or decision in the opening two sentences. - Distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions; name the single riskiest assumption. - Avoid praise, filler transitions, and unsolicited next-step menus at the end. - Disagree directly with evidence when a premise slows down or weakens the result.

Want to test how your own ChatGPT and Claude threads respond before and after pasting this block? Run five matched prompts in our blind Instruction A/B Test Bench, or compare Meta Muse alongside both assistants in Muse vs ChatGPT vs Claude.

faq.q: Is Claude or ChatGPT more agreeable by default?
faq.a: Both score near the top of the Big Five Agreeableness scale (44.99–47.07 out of 50 in September 2026 tests), with Claude Opus 5.5 recording the highest mean Agreeableness (47.07) and lowest DISC Dominance (4.00/20).

faq.q: Why do people experience GPT-6 Astra and Fable 5.1 differently if their Big Five scores look close?
faq.a: Small shifts around midpoint questionnaire thresholds alter type classifications dramatically (Astra tied on 29/100 OEJTS runs while Fable resolved INTJ on 98/100), and each product pairs the base model with different default UI presets, Memory injection, and Style layers.

faq.q: Can I use the same custom instructions in both ChatGPT and Claude?
faq.a: Yes—if you write short behavioral rules (under 1,500 characters) instead of vague adjectives, the same instruction block fits inside ChatGPT Custom Instructions, Claude Profile Preferences, and Meta Muse Soul.md.

faq.q: Does switching personality templates hurt reasoning accuracy?
faq.a: Across our 60-reply pilot, explicit formatting and directness instructions lifted answer-first openings from 14/20 to 19/20 and cut hedges without lowering factual accuracy, though overly rigid length limits on complex tasks can truncate nuance.
